content: Hadi de Sem, Yafeta nora Ham duratni-waitni. La'pa gera ktiowru-opli nhia'a nlardoinla, dewade rayor niana a'na muanke'a.

content.text: Yafeta duratni-waitni de:
Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek, nora Tiras.
Gomer duratni-waitni de:
Askenas, Rifat, nora Togarma.
Yawan duratni-waitni de:
Elisa, Tarsis, makden Kitim, nora makdena Dodanim.

Nwatiawua hari pa noha-rai lalawna mak kdena eni wawannu re rpeha-rlawna. Yafeta duratni-waitni hari pa ntikil reri lia yeheni me, nhapar rer lia hlorni (rima-rima ndella nohananni-taniaratni, ra'itar nohora yawalli, nlernohora luwnu-a'nani re).
Hama duratni-waitni rde:
Kusyi, Misraim, Put, nora Kana'an.
Kusyi duratni-waitni de:
Seba, Hawila, Sapta, Ra'ema nora Sapteka, Ra'ema a'nani rde, Syeba nora Dedan.

content: Kusyi duratni-waitni id de nwawa Nimrota (nnia'eratni de malawna). Hadi ed maka kala' ul pua kodi plola-ktaryat lia nohkerkeran di wawannu.
Rimormiori me Orgahi mana ramkeka de, hadi de mak khiti ahu-kler lowna na'iwra-namuanu la nohkeran di wawannu, hade pede riy rwedi ltieri riwra: “Emolmolla Nimrota, mak khiti ahu-kler lowna.”
Ululu de Nimrota lodna lie'enu me hairi liowni de, Babela, Ereka, nora Akada, honona rdella Sinear lowanni.
Nimrota ndella lowan de pa nla'awa Asyur, noka nwatatu lieta wolima, de Niniwe, Rehobot-Ira, Kala,
me leta Resen, mak kdella Niniwe nora Kala rletni, ne Niniwe de letlawna inhatta.

content.text: Misraim na'ana nana makdella Ludim, makdella Anamim, makdella Lebahim, makdella Naftuhim,
makdella Patrusim, makdella Kaftorim nora makdella Kasluhim. Makdella Kasluhim de, er mak kadurit nana makdella Filistin.
Kana'an na'a'na nana Sidon, a'nani yanulu, nora Heta,
me makden Yebusi, makdena Amori nora makdena Girgasi,
makden Hewi, makden Arki, makden Sini,
makdena Arwadi, makdena Semari, nora makdena Hamati. Rwatiawua hari pa makdena Kana'ana rpeha-rlawna.
Makdena Kana'ana lowanni-ahlani ndella Sidon pa nokru Gerar pa nokru Gasa, Sodom, Gomora, Adma nora Seboim nla tut lia Lasa.

content: Hare de Ham duratni-waitni pa ntikil reri lia yeheni me, nhapar rer lia hlorni (rima-rima ndella nohananni-taniaratni, ra'itar nohora yawalli, nlernohora luwnu-a'nani re).
Yafeta kakni de Sem. Mere Sem ed mak kadurit nana Eber (makdella Yahudi) nor Eber duratni-waitni honona.

content.text: Sem duratni-waitni de:
Elam, Asyur, Arpaksad, Lud, nora Aram.
Aram duratni-waitni de:
Us, Hul, Geter, nora Masa.
Arpaksad na'a'na nana Sela, noka Sela na'a'na nana Eber.
Eber na'a'na nana muanke'a woru, id nanni Peleg (nnia'eratni de, rhakre'era), yoma la'a lerni de rhakre'era noh di. Peleg hyalli de nanni Yoktan.
Yoktan na'a'na nana Almodad, Selef, Hasar-Mawet nora Yerah,
Hadoram, Usala, nora Dikla,
Obala, Abimaela nora Syeba,
Ofir, Hawila, Yobab. Hare honona rde, Yoktan duratni-waitni.

content: Lowanni-ahlani rde ema rweran nana la Mesa la walli warta pa nokru Sefar, de wo'ora-kawru mak kdella walli tipru.
Hari honona rde Sem duratni-waitni pa ntikil reri lia yeheni me, nhapar rer lia hlorni (rima-rima ndella nohananni-taniaratni, ra'itar nohora yawalli, nlernohora luwnu-a'nani re).
Hare de Nuh upni-a'nani honona, duratni-waitni re, nlernohora hairni re, ne nwatiawua hari pa nawer nana-napak niana rimormior noh keran di honona la' lera gera ktiowru-opli nhia'a nhio'tarnu.
